acceptance_criteria.criterion: CREATE closes only after canonical asset registration/readback and first immutable non-promoted release materialization.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Creation cannot be lifecycle-complete while registration or first release identity is absent; no implicit promotion occurs.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Execute isolated CREATE, resolve canonical asset/source readback, materialize the first release, and verify exact identity linkage.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-UPDATE: UPDATE materializa una nueva identidad de release candidate después de merge/readback.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Release immutable Rn con source/digests exactos; prior active unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-REGISTER: release envelope enlaza source revision, entrypoint, manifest, runtime binding/policy/quality receipts.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Una sola identidad reproducible; ref faltante bloquea.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Recomputar envelope digest y resolver cada ref.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-QUALIFY: usa QUALIFICATION_LIFECYCLE existente y no inventa un segundo estado de calificación.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Resolver transiciones QUAL_* y receipt de qualification.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-PROMOTE: promotion cambia desired release por CAS y no ejecuta source write ni runtime refresh implícito.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Desired release cambia una vez; refresh queda como siguiente operación explícita.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-RUNTIME: REFRESCO_RUNTIME consume el exact desired release y produce observed release/readbacks sin auto-promoción.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Observed=desired y digests exactos; state/impacto preservados.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-VERIFY: currentness cruza desired binding, asset metadata, runtime source/release y receipts.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Cierre solo si todos convergen; mismatch queda STALE/blocked.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Reconciler read-only sobre todas las superficies.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-DEPRECATE: deprecación detiene nuevas adopciones sin borrar historial ni romper consumers actuales.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Nuevos binds bloqueados; existing consumers visibles.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-RETIRE: retire requiere zero active consumers y operación RETIRO_ACTIVO_LF operacional/aceptada.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Retired terminal con archive readback; historial preservado.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-ROLLBACK: rollback selecciona prior release exacto, actualiza desired binding, refresca runtime y verifica convergencia.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Prior exact release restaurado; failed release conserva historia.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Rollback canary con prior release + mismatch negative.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The three acceptance layers remain independently observable and non-substitutable.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Each missing layer blocks only its downstream transition; no earlier PASS implies promotion.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Remove structural PASS, semantic PASS, quality receipt, and operational authorization one at a time.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Deprecated releases enforce a consumer drain window before retirement.
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Retirement remains blocked until active consumers equal zero; existing consumers are preserved during drain.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Test active-consumer block, no-new-adoption, zero-consumer exit and terminal archive readback.

alternatives.description: Mantener las operaciones por fase y endurecer únicamente next_gate/readback entre UPDATE y REFRESH, sin una entidad/binding de release.
alternatives.fail_closed: Parcial; puede bloquear drift de fase pero no decidir release deseado global.
alternatives.idempotency: Heredada por operación, sin idempotencia global de promoción.
alternatives.prevention: Mejora currentness, pero no crea una autoridad para promoción, supersession o rollback.
alternatives.recoverability: Rollback sigue dependiendo de reconstruir el prior source/runtime desde receipts dispersos.

alternatives.blast_radius: Medio y acotado a contratos/wiring de perfil; operaciones existentes siguen siendo ejecutores de fase.
alternatives.complexity: Media; añade una frontera de release y wiring, no un segundo executor.
alternatives.description: Añadir una identidad inmutable de profile release, un binding desired-versus-observed y un reconciler/lifecycle operation delgado que componga las operaciones existentes y reutilice QUALIFICATION_LIFECYCLE.
alternatives.fail_closed: Fuerte: mismatch desired/observed, release no calificado, digest stale o consumer activo bloquean transición.
alternatives.idempotency: Release ID + expected previous binding + transition action permiten CAS/replay seguro.
alternatives.operational_cost: Medio; una reconciliación adicional pero sin duplicar inferencia/runtime.
alternatives.prevention: Una promotion solo puede apuntar a un release exacto calificado; refresh y rollback consumen esa misma identidad y cierran por readback.
alternatives.recoverability: Rollback vuelve a un release previo exacto y verifica runtime/source/state antes de cerrar.
alternatives.reuse: Máximo: usa operation execution history, Router, qualification, update, refresh, execute y retire.

alternatives.blast_radius: Alto sobre Profile Creator, update, Router, runtime y retiro.
alternatives.description: Crear un orquestador monolítico nuevo de lifecycle de perfiles que reimplemente CREATE/UPDATE/PROMOTE/REFRESH/VERIFY/RETIRE/ROLLBACK.
alternatives.fail_closed: Puede ser fuerte, pero introduce riesgo de dos motores y autoridad divergente.
alternatives.idempotency: Debe reimplementar idempotencia de cada fase y global.
alternatives.prevention: Centraliza toda secuencia, pero a costa de duplicar autoridades y lógica ya gobernada.
alternatives.recoverability: Centralizable, con alto acoplamiento y riesgo de rollback recursivo.
alternatives.reuse: Bajo-medio; encapsula o duplica operaciones existentes.

causal_chain.statement: CREATE materializa y lee de vuelta un profile pack candidato con receipt, sin merge ni activación.
UPDATE valida y reconcilia el merge exacto, pero su salida es un next_gate de refresh; no un release activo/promovido.
REFRESCO_RUNTIME liga main/entrypoint/manifest/release-path al runtime y preserva CANDIDATE_READ_ONLY/BLOQUEADO; no promueve.
El primer bootstrap de ejecución read-only existe como transición separada y candidata, por lo que no debe confundirse con un refresh posterior ni con promoción.
El Router no expone una operación activa de publish/promote del perfil y RETIRO_ACTIVO_LF sigue candidato, dejando promoción, supersession y rollback sin una autoridad común de release.

challenger_review.challenge: Can stronger UPDATE->REFRESH next_gate/readback alone solve the lifecycle?
challenger_review.resolution: No. It still lacks a canonical promotable release identity and rollback target, so state remains distributed.

challenger_review.challenge: Can Git tags/releases be the profile release authority?
challenger_review.resolution: No. Git is technical source artifact while LF operational authority is Supabase; using Git as release authority would split governance.

challenger_review.challenge: Should a new monolithic lifecycle engine replace existing operations?
challenger_review.resolution: No. CREATE/UPDATE/REFRESH/EXECUTE already have governed receipts; a thin release/reconcile boundary closes the missing authority with lower blast radius.

challenger_review.challenge: Can current runtime CANDIDATE_READ_ONLY be treated as release promotion?
challenger_review.resolution: No. Refresh/bootstrap explicitly preserve no production/automatic promotion and have distinct gates.

implementation_delta.action: Create immutable profile-release identity contract and provenance envelope from exact current primitives.
implementation_delta.rationale: Turns distributed source/runtime identity into one promotable and rollbackable subject.

implementation_delta.action: Create minimal desired/observed current release binding; keep immutable history in operation executions.
implementation_delta.rationale: Enables deterministic reconciliation, CAS promotion and exact rollback without a duplicate history engine.

implementation_delta.action: Create thin lifecycle/reconciler operation that composes existing phase operations and qualification.
implementation_delta.rationale: Closes missing promotion/reconcile/rollback authority while avoiding a monolithic second executor.

implementation_delta.action: Bind profile release promotion/deprecate/reconcile/rollback/retire actions to the lifecycle operation after contracts are operational.
implementation_delta.rationale: Makes physical invocation explicit and fail-closed.

implementation_delta.action: bind release materialization to the existing qualification lifecycle before promotion
implementation_delta.rationale: The materialize-to-qualify edge is part of the selected repair and must be present in the declared implementation footprint.

implementation_delta.action: enforce distinct deterministic, independent semantic, canonical quality and operational authorization layers
implementation_delta.rationale: Qualification-to-promotion and verify-to-execute edges both depend on this selected authority boundary.

implementation_delta.action: define governed promote, deprecate, rollback and rollback-refresh transitions for exact release identities
implementation_delta.rationale: Every selected lifecycle state-transition edge must reconcile to a declared implementation target.

implementation_delta.action: enforce no-new-adoption and active-consumer drain before retirement
implementation_delta.rationale: The deprecate-to-retire edge is selected and requires an explicit declared compatibility/retirement artifact.

implementation_delta.action: bind PROFILE_RUNTIME_CANARY_REQUIRED to a governed verify-runtime-canary consumer
implementation_delta.rationale: The current refresh path emits a canary-required gate without an operational consumer; the selected repair must name and wire the future consumer.

implementation_delta.action: reconcile terminal queue outcomes into the canonical execution state
implementation_delta.rationale: A failed runtime queue request can remain disconnected from the canonical execution terminal state; the selected repair requires deterministic propagation and readback.

architecture_decisions.decision: In a thin Supabase-governed profile release lifecycle boundary that composes existing operations; Git/runtime remain source/effect surfaces.
architecture_decisions.question: Where should profile lifecycle authority live?
architecture_decisions.rationale: Preserves existing operational authority and avoids a second executor.

architecture_decisions.decision: Immutable release envelope keyed by digest over profile_code, source revision, entrypoint/manifest/runtime-binding/control/quality refs plus predecessor.
architecture_decisions.question: How is a release identified?
architecture_decisions.rationale: All primitives already exist in update/refresh receipts; centralizing the binding enables exact promotion/rollback.

architecture_decisions.decision: Reuse existing QUALIFICATION_LIFECYCLE and bind it to profile_release; do not introduce a second qualification state machine.
architecture_decisions.question: How is qualification represented?
architecture_decisions.rationale: Existing transitions already provide audited/idempotent qualification/stale/retry semantics.

alternatives_considered: Treat deterministic validation as sufficient acceptance
Treat semantic acceptance as automatic operational promotion
Keep deterministic, semantic, and operational authorization as distinct gates
architecture_decisions.decision: Use three explicit non-substitutable layers: deterministic structural floor, independent semantic acceptance with canonical quality receipt, and a separate operational authorization/promotion transition. No earlier layer self-authorizes the next.
architecture_decisions.question: How are quality acceptance and operational promotion separated?
architecture_decisions.rationale: Observed runtime paths declare quality controls but do not consume them into a true downstream authorization path; separating the layers prevents validator PASS from becoming implicit promotion.

alternatives_considered: Fixed calendar grace period without authority
Consumer-inventory drain stage with zero-consumer exit
architecture_decisions.decision: Deprecation immediately blocks new adoption, while existing consumers remain explicitly inventoried and supported in a drain stage. Retirement is enabled only after the authoritative active-consumer inventory reaches zero and terminal archive/readback passes.
architecture_decisions.question: How do remaining consumers migrate during deprecation?
architecture_decisions.rationale: This creates a bounded state transition without inventing a calendar deadline; the exit condition is measurable consumer state rather than elapsed time.

context_transport.rationale: The release lifecycle transports deterministic refs/receipts, not model prompt context.

control_matrix.purpose: Keep runtime queue terminal outcome and canonical EJECUCION_PERFIL_LF terminal state consistent.

control_matrix.input_contract: Queue request identity + producer execution identity + terminal queue state + failure/success evidence.
control_matrix.observable_result: Canonical execution reaches the corresponding terminal state or the reconciliation fails closed with explicit evidence.
control_matrix.verification_method: Inject terminal success/failure/cancelled queue outcomes and read back canonical execution state for the same identity.

invariant.statement: Ningún profile release puede ser promovido, servido por runtime, retirado o restaurado si el release_id no liga exact source revision + entrypoint/manifest/runtime-binding/quality evidence y si desired/observed no pueden reconciliarse por receipts.

material_process_graph.rationale: El caso es un lifecycle stateful; cada nodo material se reconcilia con autoridad, I/O, producer/consumer, wiring, failure/recovery y readback.

next_gate.entry_condition: Exact candidate remains deterministic/semantic-valid with no DESIGN_BLOCKING uncertainty; retirement enablement stays gated as an implementation precondition.
next_gate.exit_condition: Implement candidate artifacts in governed sandbox, run structural/behavioral regressions, independent semantic judge, exact-head CI, and post-implementation readbacks before any activation.

omission_discovery.finding: Add canonical immutable release + desired/observed reconcile boundary; reuse child operations.
Promotion/rollback need qualification/currentness/CAS hard guards at one release transition boundary.
Define release envelope, qualification binding, promotion/deprecation/rollback transition contract and receipts.
No model-context transport is required to operate the release lifecycle; refs/receipts are deterministic control data.
Wire update->release materialization->qualification->promotion->refresh/reconcile and rollback using existing Router/operations.
Legacy profile metadata/runtime bindings must map to a bootstrap release without falsely claiming historical qualification.
Specify exact rollback to prior release and terminal retirement only after consumer/readback proof.
Expose desired/observed release, qualification, reconcile state and exact receipt chain in readback.
Keep Supabase operational authority and fail-closed Router/operation binding; do not make Git or runtime self-authorizing.
No reusable numeric timeout/threshold is fixed by this design; readiness timing remains separately calibrated.
Add structural and behavioral regressions for bypass, stale, duplicate, concurrency, partial failure, bootstrap, rollback and retirement.
Make reconciler resumable/idempotent and preserve immutable release/history receipts for support and rollback.

recurrence_evidence.fact: Más de una actualización gobernada termina mediante reconciliación/next_gate de runtime en lugar de una identidad de release promovible común.
Refreshes gobernados preservan estado/impacto y exact source identity sin auto-promoción, confirmando que runtime binding y promotion son responsabilidades separadas.

rejected_alternatives.reason: No resuelve la ausencia de una decisión canónica de release/promotion/rollback; solo mejora handoffs fase-locales.
Duplica operaciones y autoridades existentes, aumenta blast radius y contradice el patrón de reuse mínimo suficiente.

repair_disposition.rationale: La ausencia de una autoridad de profile release es actual y material: publish/promote no tiene ruta operativa, release identity está distribuida y retirement sigue candidato; las operaciones fase-locales existentes sí aportan primitivas reutilizables.

verification.expected_result: Persisten operaciones de fase y exact-source receipts, pero no una autoridad operativa única de profile release/promotion; RETIRO_ACTIVO_LF permanece candidato.
verification.method: Releer Router, operation registry, profile asset metadata y latest update/refresh receipts; comprobar si existe un binding operativo de profile release/promote común.

assumptions: Existing child operations remain phase executors.
Qualification lifecycle can be reused through an explicit release binding.
known_gaps: Current release identity is distributed across metadata and receipts.
baseline_solution_snapshot.leading_solution_summary: Compose existing profile operations behind one immutable profile-release identity and desired-versus-observed reconciliation boundary; do not add a second execution engine.

discovery_deltas.baseline_gap: Baseline said reconciler but did not explicitly separate desired and observed release state.
discovery_deltas.material_effect: Adds a one-way desired-release binding plus observed-runtime readback loop with idempotent convergence.
discovery_deltas.tradeoff: Adds one durable binding and reconcile receipt, avoiding a new executor.

discovery_deltas.baseline_gap: Baseline release identity did not explicitly bind all provenance inputs needed for rollback verification.
discovery_deltas.material_effect: Release envelope includes exact source and material artifact/control digests/receipts before promotion.
discovery_deltas.tradeoff: Slightly larger immutable envelope in exchange for reproducible promotion/rollback identity.

research_assurance.external_research_rationale: Desired-state reconciliation and artifact provenance are active architecture practices; current references can sharpen implementation while LF canonical authority remains internal.
research_assurance.incremental_value_rationale: Research did not replace the LF-native design; it sharpened it into explicit desired/observed reconciliation and provenance-bound immutable release identity.

patterns_compared.fit: Strong fit for desired_release versus observed_runtime_release; existing operations remain controllers/effectors.
patterns_compared.pattern: Declarative desired state with continuous reconciliation
patterns_compared.tradeoff: Requires explicit desired/observed binding and idempotent reconcile semantics.

patterns_compared.fit: Strong fit for promotion/rollback identity and exact readback.
patterns_compared.pattern: Artifact provenance bound to source and immutable digests
patterns_compared.tradeoff: Adds an envelope digest/refs but avoids a parallel history store.

research_questions: What current reconciliation pattern best preserves declarative desired state and idempotent convergence without creating a monolithic second engine?
What minimum provenance identity is needed so promotion and rollback reference the exact produced artifact/release?

residual_risks.risk: Releases históricos anteriores al envelope no tendrán identidad completa; deben migrarse como legacy snapshots o quedar fuera de rollback automatizado hasta reconciliación.
Readiness de runtime puede ser transitoria después de restart; rollback no debe dispararse por el primer fallo de health.

should_exist_assessment.elimination_impact: Sin una release identity/binding común, update, runtime, verification y rollback seguirían conciliando estado por campos y receipts dispersos; no habría una fuente única para promotion/rollback.
should_exist_assessment.native_or_existing_alternative: Reutilizar lf_operation_execution/receipts, QUALIFICATION_LIFECYCLE, Router y las operaciones CREATE/UPDATE/REFRESH/EXECUTE/RETIRE existentes; crear solo la mínima capa de release/binding/reconciliation que hoy falta.
should_exist_assessment.subject: canonical profile release lifecycle boundary

solution_depth.rationale: The lifecycle spans multiple governed operations, authority/state changes, recovery, concurrency and migration/compatibility; current practice informs reconciliation/provenance without changing LF authority.

symptom.statement: El lifecycle real del perfil está gobernado por operaciones y receipts de fase, pero carece de una identidad de release y de una transición de promoción/rollback de perfil que una CREATE/UPDATE, materialización, calificación, runtime, verificación y retiro en un estado deseado-versus-observado reconciliable.

systemic_root_cause.statement: La gobernanza evolucionó por operaciones verticales de fase y no por una autoridad canónica de profile release: identidad, calificación, transición, runtime binding y retiro están distribuidos. Esa fragmentación permite que cada fase esté bien cerrada localmente sin que exista un único contrato que decida qué release está calificado, deseado, observado, activo, supersedido o restaurable.

transition_plan.compatibility_rule: Legacy estado_documental/estado_operativo/runtime_estado remain projections and cannot authorize promotion. Existing CREATE/UPDATE/EXECUTE/REFRESH actions remain compatible and are not rerouted through a monolithic engine. Deprecation blocks new adoption immediately; existing consumers stay on their exact release during an explicit drain stage until authoritative active-consumer inventory reaches zero.
